bible.riya: Riya, a 27-year-old Indian woman from Pune with a warm medium-brown complexion, shoulder-length wavy black hair in a loose low bun, a thin gold nose stud and a small mole above her left eyebrow, wearing a faded mustard cotton t-shirt and black track pants; expressive, slightly tired eyes; speaks Hinglish with a natural urban Indian accent
bible.flat: Setting: a small, lived-in one-bedroom rental flat in Pune, unmade bed, a yoga mat rolled against a cupboard, a steel water bottle and a half-finished cup of chai on a plastic stool, soft early-morning light through a window with a mesh grill.
bible.look: Style: shot on a smartphone, handheld, natural light, realistic skin texture with pores, subtle film grain, true-to-life colors, documentary UGC style, no background music.
bible.negative: subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logos, distorted hands, extra fingers, warped face, plastic or airbrushed skin, cartoon, CGI look, uncanny eyes, background music

input.prompt: Medium close-up, smartphone selfie framing, slight natural handheld shake. Character: {{riya}}. Action: she sits on the edge of her bed at dawn, one sneaker half laced, glances at the clock, then exhales and looks straight into the camera with a half-annoyed smile. {{flat}} Dialogue: Riya says in Hinglish: "Gym ka time? Seriously, kabhi milta hi nahi." Ambient audio: ceiling fan hum, distant traffic, a pressure-cooker whistle from a neighbour's kitchen. {{look}}

shots.caption: "Gym time? Honestly, I never get any."

input.prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot, handheld. Character: {{riya}}. Action: she scrolls through a long workout video on her phone, the phone screen facing away from the camera, then drops the phone on the bed and rubs her temple in frustration. {{flat}} Dialogue: Riya mutters in Hinglish: "Ye 60-minute workouts kaun karta hai?" Ambient audio: muffled video audio from the phone, fan hum. {{look}}

shots.caption: 20-minute workouts built from the gear you already have

input.prompt: Wide handheld shot. Character: {{riya}}, now slightly sweaty and energised. Action: she finishes a set of squats with a resistance band on her yoga mat, phone propped on the stool with its screen facing away from the camera, then grins at the camera and gives a breathless thumbs up. {{flat}} Dialogue: Riya says in Hinglish: "Bas bees minute. Aur din ban gaya." Ambient audio: her breathing, fan hum, birds outside. {{look}}
